title: Peerless
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.45 Linked Discourses 1.45
  • 5. Ādittavagga 5. On Fire

Anomasutta Peerless

“Anomanāmaṁ nipuṇatthadassiṁ, “Behold him of peerless name who sees the subtle meaning, Paññādadaṁ kāmālaye asattaṁ; giver of wisdom, unattached to the realm of sensuality: Taṁ passatha sabbaviduṁ sumedhaṁ, the all-knower, so very intelligent, Ariye pathe kamamānaṁ mahesin”ti. the great seer treading the noble road.”
